ios.desc:
Stuck in an argument and can't tell who's right? Dispunet is the
world's first Dispute Solving Social Network — post your side,
get real feedback from your trusted circle or the community, and
let AI help you see it clearly.

WHY DISPUNET?
 Post Your Dispute — friend drama, relationship fights,
   roommate chaos, workplace conflicts. Lay it out, judgment-free.
Get Real Verdicts — your trusted circle votes, or open it to
   the community for an honest outside view.
AI-Powered Clarity — get a neutral, balanced take before
   emotions take over.
 Your Call, Your Privacy — post privately to your circle, or
   anonymously to the community. You choose who sees what.
 Browse & Vote — scroll real disputes, vote who's right, and
   see how others would've handled it.

Stop replaying the same argument in your head. Post it. Get
clarity. Move on.

Download Dispunet and settle it — for good.
Resolve disputes. Gather opinions. Solve small fights with your loved ones and don't let small disputes turned into a big issue – powered by AI.

Dispunet is a unique social network built to help people settle disagreements in a fair, engaging, and community-driven way. Whether it’s a friendly argument or a serious conflict, Dispunet allows you to create disputes, add trusted circle members, and get real-time feedback from the community.

Key Features
Create and Manage Disputes – Describe your conflict, set a resolution timer, and invite circle members to participate.

Clarifications and Comments – Dispute members can give clarifications, while others share opinions in the comment section.

Vote Guilty or Innocent – The community decides — track votes until the timer ends, then view the final verdict.

AI Expert Advice – After the dispute ends, our AI analyzes title, description, clarifications, comments, and vote counts to generate insightful advice.

Circle System – Search and connect with other users, add them to your circle, and participate in their disputes.

Earn Points – Gain Noble Points when disputes you win conclude, and earn Supporter Points if your vote aligns with an “Innocent” verdict in your circle.

Dispute Timer & Results – Set how long the dispute will run; after the timer expires, results are declared instantly.

Why Choose Dispunet?
Dispunet blends social networking, gamification, and AI-powered insights to bring fairness and fun into resolving disagreements. Build your reputation, make meaningful connections, and help shape community justice.

Perfect For
Frie
